samples.description: Annual standardized differences for 1985–2002, one row per calendar year of the quarter end (18 trend-regression observations), computed from the screened common firm-quarter sample. The source reports 111,485 firm-quarter observations; this build retained 160,659 after CAR trimming, a 49,174-observation discrepancy not isolated to one construction step.

assumptions: The annual grouping year is the IBES fiscal-period-end calendar year.

The executed build uses split-unadjusted IBES ACTU/DETU with dated relative CRSP CFACSHR ratios as a sensitivity-style approximation. It is not the paper's split-adjusted primary or its I/B/E/S-factor unadjusting sensitivity (physical p. 15/printed p. 437). Actuals are screened on CURR_ACT=USD and stored forecasts on REPORT_CURR=USD; CURR and CURRFL are retained as estimate-level provenance. CRSP PRC is the USD price proxy.

The common sample uses a unique effective-dated CUSIP-to-CRSP link, the first available nonzero CRSP close within 10 calendar days after fiscal-quarter start, next-market-day mapping for nontrading announcements, CRSP VWRETD market adjustment, and 1st/99th percentile CAR trimming.
The trend fit uses conventional OLS standard errors because the paper does not state a covariance estimator.
The annual grouping year is the IBES fiscal-period-end calendar year.

The t−4 actual is the unique nearest IBES ticker period within seven days of the same fiscal-quarter date one year earlier, then placed on the current quarter-opening CRSP share basis. This unadjusted ACTU/DETU construction is a sensitivity-style approximation, not the paper's split-adjusted primary basis or its I/B/E/S-factor unadjusting sensitivity. Actuals and stored forecasts are USD before matching; forecasts are restricted to quarterly FPI codes.

The common sample uses a unique effective-dated CUSIP-to-CRSP link, the first available nonzero CRSP close within 10 calendar days after fiscal-quarter start, next-market-day mapping for nontrading announcements, CRSP VWRETD market adjustment, and 1st/99th percentile CAR trimming.
The trend fit uses conventional OLS standard errors because the paper does not state a covariance estimator.
The annual grouping year is the IBES fiscal-period-end calendar year.

The forecast is the mean split-unadjusted estimate across identified analysts on the latest announcement date strictly before actual EPS announcement; each analyst-date keeps its latest time-stamped record. Stored company-level currency is screened to USD, and the raw CURR/CURRFL received-currency fields are retained.

The executed build uses split-unadjusted IBES ACTU/DETU with dated relative CRSP CFACSHR ratios as a sensitivity-style approximation. It is not the paper's split-adjusted primary or its I/B/E/S-factor unadjusting sensitivity (physical p. 15/printed p. 437). Actuals are screened on CURR_ACT=USD and stored forecasts on REPORT_CURR=USD. CRSP PRC is the USD price proxy.
The common sample uses a unique effective-dated CUSIP-to-CRSP link, next-market-day mapping for nontrading announcements, CRSP VWRETD market adjustment, and 1st/99th percentile CAR trimming.
The trend fit uses conventional OLS standard errors because the paper does not state a covariance estimator.

limitations: The executed estimates use an unadjusted, relative-CRSP-factor sensitivity-style approximation. The paper's split-adjusted primary and its I/B/E/S-factor unadjusting sensitivity cannot be constructed exactly from the frozen catalog: adjusted ACT/DET products are present, but no historical I/B/E/S per-share price history or documented Detail Adjustments file is available. The separate SPLIT_GUIDANCE product is not assumed to be that file. CRSP relative factors keep the approximation internally on the CRSP share basis; they do not establish an I/B/E/S terminal basis (physical p. 15/printed p. 437; Detail History guide physical pp. 16, 18–19).

The paper names I/B/E/S stock prices but does not state the exact data field or quarter-opening date convention. The build uses the first available nonzero CRSP close from quarter start through 10 calendar days later as a USD-per-share proxy; it reports price ages and does not apply a separate age filter.
The local historical IBES/CRSP link and present-vintage coverage are not confirmed ex ante; the build reports link cardinality, field/currency coverage, and sample attrition.
The source does not fully specify the CAR market index, within-day event timing, exact quantile convention, or trend-regression covariance estimator.

The provider notes that actual announcement-date coverage before January 1999 may reflect activation dates; the local ANNDATS field is used as the best available event-date proxy and is audited against ACTDATS.

The executed main firm-quarter sample is 160,659 versus the paper’s 111,485. Population, period joins, missingness, link cardinality, prices, and event returns were diagnosed; the discrepancy remains unresolved and is not attributed solely to data vintage.
